latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the video-animation skill.
- Instantly animate uploaded images or video clips into 1080p MP4 videos with AI-powered motion effects.
- Streamlined workflow for marketers and content creators; no need to adjust sliders or learn complex animation tools.
- Supports multiple formats (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, etc.) up to 500MB file size.
- Automatic authentication and cloud rendering with clear feedback and error handling.
- Actions include upload, animate, export, check credits/balance, and session state management.
